cues: During furniture assembly, a compact hand tool turns panel screws while another tightens nuts on nearby brackets.
A maintenance kit keeps interchangeable bits beside tools for tightening bolts and fastening small metal panels.
When a cabinet hinge loosens, its recessed screws and mounting nuts may both need attention.
Technicians keep several hand tools nearby when appliance panels, brackets, and threaded fittings require adjustment.
At a roadside repair, a loose battery clamp and rattling panel call for different tools.
The workshop drawer holds tools for securing shelf joints, turning small screws, and tightening connecting hardware.
A homeowner secures a light-switch plate before snugging the nuts that hold its mounting bracket.
During bicycle maintenance, compact tools fasten accessory brackets and tighten bolts around the frame.
